ai.summary: AD_PLACEMENT_CPC_GEO_FLOOR_CENTS in common/src/constants/freebuff-topups.ts drops from 50 to 10. This sets the minimum billing rate for individual clicks in low-conversion countries after geo scaling, distinct from the campaign base floor. eli5.text: You may have noticed that clicks on ads in some countries used to be skipped entirely if the revenue would have been too small, usually below 5 cents. Those clicks now generate a minimum charge of 10 cents, so that ad inventory gets monetized instead of being left with no value. This only affects the smallest payouts from low-converting countries, leaving larger ad rates untouched.

ai.title: Token totals and rendering added to common util
ai.summary: A new `common/src/util/tokens.ts` module introduces `totalTokens`, `freshInputTokens`, and `formatTokens` as the single definition for every surface that reports how many tokens Freebuff moved. `totalTokens` sums `inputTokens` plus `outputTokens` and fixes a prior double-count where cache reads were added again on top of `prompt_tokens`, which already includes the cached prefix. `freshInputTokens` subtracts `cacheReadTokens` from `inputTokens`, clamped at zero for providers that over-report cache reads, and `formatTokens` renders exact counts below 10,000 and abbreviated counts from thousands up to trillions.
ai.evidence: New file `common/src/util/tokens.ts` defines `totalTokens`, `freshInputTokens`, and `formatTokens` and exports them; no existing reader is modified in this commit, per the module doc comment that says this figure is reported on more than one surface and once had two variants that disagreed.
ai.unknowns: The commit adds the shared token utilities with no reader wired up yet, so which Freebuff surface will consume `totalTokens`, `freshInputTokens`, and `formatTokens` first is not shown in the diff.

facts: GLM 5.3 Flash's pickable ladder, `low` and `high`, and deliberately NOT the whole of what the endpoint declares.

NOT a change to what BYOK and direct-API callers may send. MERGE_EFFORT_ALIASES still maps OpenRouter's wider enum onto the gateway's declared three, `max` included: a caller paying their own bill keeps the rung. This list governs what Freebuff itself picks and offers.

ai.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash's picker ladder in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts now offers only `low` and `high`, removing the `max` rung because at that reasoning depth the model re-reads the same files and re-plans the same step instead of converging on agent work. ai.title: Sponsored proposal channel logic added to common
ai.summary: A new `common/src/ads/sponsored-proposal-view.ts` module adds the channel logic that turns a sponsored proposal row into a rendering-agnostic view model, defining `SponsoredProposalState`, `SPONSORED_STATE_TITLE`, `sponsoredProposalViewModel`, and the gated helpers `sponsoredPullRequestHref`, `sponsoredLogoToken`, and `sponsoredLogoSrc`. eli5.text: If you use the free coding assistant, running your normal update command now pulls in version 0.0.165, which adds a few new capabilities for people on paid tiers and the free plan. Paid subscribers on higher-tier plans can now get routed to a partner service called Imprezia for some ad requests, and the free tier's time-window picker now shows three options (today, week, and month) instead of just today. facts: Which moment a client says it is reporting, on OUR wire (the beacon strings above are Imprezia's). Absent means insertion, so builds predating the viewable path keep their meaning. Both impression endpoints import it: a word one accepted and the other rejected would silently lose one surface.
MRC50 viewability: an ad counts as viewed once at least 50% of its pixels have been continuously visible for one full second while the page is in the foreground.

"Continuous" is the whole difficulty. Scrolling the ad half out of view, or backgrounding the tab, restarts the clock from zero rather than pausing it, so this is a small state machine rather than an accumulator.
Called exactly once, when the criteria have been met.
Dropped below the bar before the second elapsed, reset, don't pause.

ai.summary: The `thinker-gemini` agent, spawned by base-chat for Freebuff chat complex problems, now runs on `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID` instead of `'google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview'`, after the Google credit grant covering it expired and list-price Gemini 3.1 Pro became ~$2,700/week versus ~$70-85/week for DeepSeek V4 Flash at the same ~52k-token re-read volume. Reasoning is now declared explicitly with enabled: true and `effort` set to `high`, since the DeepSeek lane maps that onto its thinking flag and a thinker that does not think is just a slower copy of the root. The `id` stays `thinker-gemini` because it is registered in `chat/agent.ts`, named in the hidden-agent list and `FREEBUFF_GEMINI_PRO_AGENT_IDS`, and spawned by name in base-chat's prompt, so renaming would touch all of them without benefit.
